name: Age limits
description: Goods for adults: an age on a category (with everything under it), on a product or on the whole shop. A visitor who has not said they are old enough sees such goods with their photos covered, or does not find them in lists and search at all; an order of them asks for a tick and tells the manager to check an ID on delivery. A tick proves nothing — the document at the door does.

settings.label: Where an age is set
settings.help: Every category and product with an age, in one list. An age is set on the category's or the product's own form, beside "Who sees it".

settings.label: A visitor who has not confirmed their age sees
settings.help: For every age rule that does not choose its own. Photos covered: every photo of such goods becomes a plate saying 18+, in lists, on the product's page, in the basket, in the sitemap and in what the page tells search engines. Not in lists or search: the goods open only by their own address, and their category's page asks for the age first; a category's place in the menu is its status. Either way the page of such a product, and of its category, carries a strip with "I am 18 or older", and the goods are shown once it is pressed. Shown as usual: the age is asked only with the order.

settings.label: Age for the whole shop
settings.help: 0 — only the categories and products that have an age on their form. A number — every product of the shop is for that age and older, shown as chosen above: a shop of alcohol or of goods for adults.

options.restricted: On the pages of goods and categories with an age
options.everywhere: On every page, until the visitor answers

settings.label: The window "Are you 18 or older?"
settings.help: A window over the page that asks before showing it. It is a courtesy, not a check: anybody can press it, and the page behind it is still there for search engines. The answer is kept in the browser for 30 days.

settings.label: A tick at checkout
settings.help: "I am 18 or older", required for an order of goods with an age, at checkout and in one click. The order then carries a note for the manager to check a document when it is handed over. An order a manager creates in the admin, through the API or from 1C carries the note without a tick.
